summary: Central network session message dispatcher (netcomm session message handling). Reads the incoming message word a2[0], requires the high header bits (v3 & 0xE0000000) == 0x80000000, then switches on (v3 >> 18) & 0x3F. Each case handles a distinct session event: session start (2), player grid/line-up broadcast (3), server data copy into vehicle slots (4), next-track transition (5), driver-data boot / boot-notification (6 and 0x20), color/effect trigger (0x23), terrain validation with per-player path building and mismatch reporting (0x24), a terrain queue drain/re-fill (0x27), session-state-code writes (0x28/0x29), and a per-player terrain-height check that adjusts a terrain-threshold float (0x2A). Unmatched types fall to a tail that forwards the raw message into a staging buffer via ArithmeticComparison_3a90 when the player byte matches the session type. Returns 1 on handled messages; 0 when the header check fails.
